fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Jump-capable infantry provide the vertical mobility that AFFS commanders prize in urban combat and rough terrain, able to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions that ground-bound platoons cannot reach. Carrying heavy assault rifles alongside their standard arms, these platoons pack a harder punch than standard rifle formations, trading some logistical simplicity for increased stopping power against armored targets.
